acceptance_rule: PIT trailing-90d covariance only (no lookahead) at each monthly rebalance. Compare risk-budget overlay vs static hold of the same held names over the 3 standard windows. Accept if aggregate expected_value_score (total_return x sharpe) improves AND max-drawdown reduces, with total return not materially worse (>-15pct), turnover/cost realistic. Report per-window. Flag survivorship: universe = currently-held names. Observed-only; production path = discretionary risk policy.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Held-book risk-budget overlay: applying a PIT risk-contribution cap (cap any single name at 15% of ex-ante portfolio risk) plus a 30% annualized vol target (excess to cash), rebalanced monthly using ONLY trailing 90d covariance, improves risk-adjusted return (Sharpe up, max-drawdown down) at acceptable return cost versus static buy-and-hold of the same held names, aggregated over the three standard windows. Motivated by the read-only diagnostic (scripts/probe_held_book_concentration.py): MUU alone is 34% of portfolio risk and the only real de-risk lever is raising cash, not rotating among correlated high-beta names. Observed-only policy simulation on the held universe; no core-strategy/order/ranking change; discretionary risk policy if it wins.

nearest.reopen_condition: Forward replacement-value rows, a shared production/replay alpha_score adapter, or a materially new component-level ranking field. Do not mine nearby alpha_score risk formulas on the same frozen replay.

If promising, create a separate default-off or strategy Gate 1-4 experiment with shared production-visible ranking logic. If not promising, do not promote this simple additive expectation/residual component; pivot to PEAD eligibility or richer expectation fields.

novelty.new_evidence_axis: First risk-contribution-cap + vol-target overlay on the live HELD book (operator_inputs/open_positions.json) using PIT trailing covariance, redeploy-to-cash. Distinct from prior macro-selloff rebalance allocator and loss-streak risk work: this is a standing single-name/portfolio risk-budget policy on discretionary+legacy holds, not a regime trigger or core-strategy sizing change.

prediction.confidence_reason: Diagnostic strongly implies vol-target-to-cash cuts vol with Sharpe ~unchanged; but trailing Sharpe is bull-window-inflated and static hold of winners is a hard baseline to beat on return.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The 30% vol target forced 18-33% cash in the two bull windows, capping high-beta winners to ~45% upside capture; the ~34pp return give-up dominated the ~30pp worst-drawdown reduction, halving aggregate EV (44.4->18.6). Net-helped only in old_thin, the drawdown window (-12%->-1%, DD 44%->11%).
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep the single-name risk cap, vol target, lookback, or rebalance frequency on this held universe - that is a parameter retune of a rejected static-target overlay.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A regime-CONDITIONED overlay (de-risk only in adverse/chop regimes via the PIT regime classifier, full in confirmed uptrends), a tail-risk-weighted objective (the overlay already wins on drawdown), or genuinely uncorrelated/low-beta ballast.
